title.narrative: Collaborative, multi sectorial lean season response to the humanitarian needs in Konduga (Kaleri and Musakaleri) and Mafa (Simari, Zannari and Malakyareri) local government of Borno state.

description.narrative: ltpgtThe proposed multi-sectorial intervention aims to deliver a comprehensive, lifesaving response to address acute malnutrition, improve health outcomes and mainstream a robust prevention to GBV in Konduga and Mafa LGAs of Borno State through an integrated, community-based approach. ltbrgtIn Konduga and Mafa, the project will focus on responding to the health, and nutrition needs, while mainstreaming GBV prevention initiatives directly benefiting approximately 23,000 individuals. The project will scale up treatment for Severe Acute Malnutrition and Moderate Acute Malnutrition among children under five, pregnant and breastfeeding women and girls. It will also deliver Maternal, Infant and Young Child Nutrition (MIYCN) counselling, promote community-based active case finding, and integrate relapse prevention through the distribution of Ready-to-Use Supplementary Foods (RUSF), micronutrient powders (MNPs), and Supplemental Nutrition Assistance (SNA).ltbrgtThe health intervention is expected to focus on women of reproductive age, children under five, persons with disabilities, and the elderly, and will contribute to the reduction of preventable morbidity and mortality across the two LGAs.ltbrgtIn response to the growing strain on the primary healthcare systems in Konduga LGA, this component will restore access to essential, lifesaving health services across eight targeted communities, building on JDF’s long-standing local presence and community trust.ltbrgtThe intervention will strengthen primary healthcare delivery through mobile outreach models and Clinical referrals, covering:ltbrgt Routine immunizationltbrgt Antenatal and postnatal careltbrgt Treatment of common illnesses (malaria, pneumonia, diarrhea)ltbrgt Sexual and reproductive health (SRH) servicesltbrgt Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS)ltbrgt Health education and promotionltbrgtThis project will adopt a multi-faceted approach to protect women and girls through prevention, and mitigation of Gender -Based Violence this will be achieved through awareness creation and sensitization to break-down societal constructs and gender norms, including referral services to GBV survivors, Psychosocial support services will be provided for women and girls as well as mainstreaming PSEA. The project will also ensure that staff capacity is strengthened on the referral pathway for GBV survivors accessing health and nutrition services through trainings, safety audits will also be conducted on the health and nutrition facilities to ensure meaniful access for vulnerable groups. lt/pgtltpgtThe project will distribute hybrid kits (NFI and Dignity kits) to women and girls to support their well-being and dignity. women and girls accessing the health facilities will be empowered with VSLA trainings and groups formation.ltbrgtImplemented under a consortium framework, with technical oversight and quality assurance by JDF, the program will collaborate with a local national NGO, New Foundation for Displaced Persons (NFDP) to ensure effective delivery, build local capacity, and embeds a robust monitoring and accountability framework. The intervention is designed to be gender-sensitive, conflict-aware, and accessible to vulnerable groups prioritizing persons with disabilities, incorporating protection/GBV.ltbrgtThis six (6) month initiative aligns with the 2025 Lean Season Response Plan, Sector priorities, and the NHF allocation strategy and will be implemented in line with the Borno state 25 years developmental plan, and in close collaboration with key stakeholders from the state ministries and departments, (Health, women affairs, Borno state primary health care board) community gate keepers and the respective sector groups. lt/pgt
